node.title: Portmanteau Characterization of Weak Convergence
node.body: Let (mu_n) be a sequence of probability measures and mu a probability measure on a metric space S with its Borel sigma-algebra. The following are equivalent: (i) mu_n converges weakly to mu, meaning integral of f d mu_n converges to integral of f d mu for every bounded continuous f: S -> R; (ii) limsup_n mu_n(F) <= mu(F) for every closed set F; (iii) liminf_n mu_n(G) >= mu(G) for every open set G; (iv) mu_n(A) converges to mu(A) for every Borel set A with mu(boundary of A) = 0. [standard, e.g. Billingsley, Convergence of Probability Measures]
